newsitem.title: IRAN: Ninety percent of Iranian oil exported ex-Kharg.
newsitem.headline: Ninety percent of Iranian oil exported ex-Kharg.

text.p: Iran's Kharg Island terminal accounts for 90 percent of the state's 2.6 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude exports, Mohammad Souri, chairman of National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC), said on Sunday.
The remaining 10 percent was exported from the Sirri and Lavan Island terminals, also in the Gulf, he told Reuters.

Kharg Island's T-jetty could simultaneously load up to 10 vessels with a maximum tanker size of 280,000 deadweight tonnes (dwt). Three vessels of up to 500,000 dwt each could be handled at the four jetties of Kharg's Sea Island.
NITC is responsible for the transport of 950,000 bpd of National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) crude exports of 2.6 milllion bpd.
Its has a tanker fleet of 3.5 million dwt comprising 11 crude cargoes and nine product carriers.
Iran is the world's third largest oil exporter.
